tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground on every device. Light: cashier, tablets, phones. Dark: KDS and any screen read from across a room.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, inputs: anything that sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the PIN pad tray, read-only values, the strip behind a list.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons, on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and every `*-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (help lines, timestamps, 'paired by') on the three surfaces. Never for anything a cook must read.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Large text (24px+) and icons only, on `surface`: placeholders' icons, disabled marks. 3:1, not body text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around cards. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: input borders, secondary buttons, tiles. 3:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button: one per screen, the thing the screen is for.

tokens.name: action-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while held down.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `action` and `action-pressed`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Identity and selection only: the selected tile, the active PIN dot, the display-code underline. Never a status, never a button fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-row and selected-tile ground; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done / paired / approved. Blue, not green, so it never depends on red-green vision against `danger`. Always with the check icon and a word. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `ok-tint`.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an ok banner or ok screen.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Wait / busy / expiring soon / reconnecting. Always with the clock or sync icon and a word. Text on `surface` and `warn-tint`.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a warn banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong PIN, locked, revoked, failed. Always with the alert icon and a word. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `danger-tint`; also the danger button fill (light theme text `on-action`).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger banner and an input in error.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices (e.g. 'Ask a manager'). Text on `surface` and `info-tint`.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an info banner.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset so it always lands on the surface, never on a fill.

tokens.name: qr-tile
tokens.usage: The white tile behind every QR code, in both themes. QR modules are black.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and blocking sheets.

styles.name: code-display
styles.usage: Pairing display code on a screen waiting to be paired; readable at 3 m. Always LTR.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: A code typed or shown inside a form; registration codes. Always LTR.

styles.name: value-mono
styles.usage: IP addresses, CIDRs, device ids. Always LTR.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one headline on a full-screen state (pair screen, blocking screens).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title on phones and tablets.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ask a manager to pair this screen.
styles.usage: Default text on kiosk, tablet and KDS.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text on phones; never smaller for anything staff must read.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Help lines and metadata in `ink-muted`. Not on KDS.

styles.name: ur-display
styles.usage: Urdu counterpart of `display`. Nastaliq needs ~1.9x line height; never put it in a fixed-height box.

styles.name: ur-body
styles.sample: مینیجر سے کہیں کہ اس اسکرین کو جوڑیں۔
styles.usage: Urdu body and labels on every device. One step larger than Latin `body` because Nastaliq reads small.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside small labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; between PIN dots.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between keys on the PIN pad and tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the page gutter at 360px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet/kiosk; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Outer margin of full-screen states on kiosk and KDS.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, PIN keys, staff tiles, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the QR tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: PIN dots and status badges.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest height or width of anything tappable, on every device.

tokens.name: touch-kitchen
tokens.usage: Tappable size on KDS and on the pair screen: wet hands, tapped while walking.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a form column on kiosk/tablet; phones use full width minus `space-4`.

tokens.name: qr-size
tokens.usage: QR code edge on a screen waiting to be paired (scannable at ~1 m). 200px on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs. Dark theme uses an edge, not a shadow.
